I transform messy, large data into comprehensive stories and actionable insights.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [addresses and predicts rising stream temperatures in Salem, Oregon](capstone.qmd) for the City of Salem.

To get into more details, I am an emerging data scientist specializing in environmental data analysis. I am interested in using data science for positive change. I focus my work on community, viewing collaboration as not only helpful but also necessary. My experience includes scientific research, spatial data, data quality, and survey design and analysis. 

Specialties:

- Languages: Python, R

- Software: ArcGIS, QGIS, PIX4D, Global Mapper Pro, Cloud Compare, Power BI, Microsoft Excel

- Problem Solving: Investigative approach, breaking down complex challenges, detail-oriented execution

- Leadership & Collaboration: Team organization, clear communication, mentorship

- Values: Community-focused solutions, ethical AI development

**Currently looking for** data analyst / data scientist roles
starting September 1st, 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
